_readme: Starter heartbeat conditions. Copy this file to a bot's workspace, next to
conditions to match that bot's checklist, then flip 'enabled' to true.
What it does: before a heartbeat or cron tick wakes the bot's model, Evolve
evaluates these conditions from files and the clock. Nothing due means no
model call at all. Something due means the bot wakes with just that item.
It ships DISABLED on purpose. A conditions file decides whether a turn runs,
so it starts working only once someone has read it and meant it. Until then
(and on any bot with no file at all) every heartbeat wakes the model exactly

conditions.wake: Work through everything in inbox/ and clear it.
Re-read memory/notes.md and act on what changed since last time.
Run the full HEARTBEAT.md checklist — this is the periodic catch-all for anything the conditions above do not cover.
